official_sources.title: Raster Data Model
official_sources.finding: Affine geotransform maps pixel/line to georeferenced coordinates; pixel (0,0) is the top-left corner and the first pixel center is (0.5,0.5).

official_sources.title: Geotransform Tutorial
official_sources.finding: Six geotransform coefficients define row/column addressing; north-up rasters typically use zero rotation and negative Y pixel size.

official_sources.title: RFC 33 PixelIsPoint
official_sources.finding: PixelIsArea and PixelIsPoint differ semantically and historical interpretation can shift apparent georeferencing by half a pixel.

official_sources.title: gdalbuildvrt
official_sources.finding: VRT mosaics can alter resolution, extent, resampling, nodata and overlap priority; default overlap uses input ordering.

official_sources.title: gdal raster mosaic
official_sources.finding: Mosaic extent/resolution/alignment/nodata and pixel functions are explicit; uncovered output can become zero unless nodata or alpha is defined.

official_sources.title: gdaltindex
official_sources.finding: Tile indexes retain raster paths and footprints; GTI use should pin resolution, datatype, nodata/mask and source SRS.

official_sources.title: VRT driver
official_sources.finding: VRT can select srcwin/projwin, override geotransform, change resolution, resample and unscale; terminal evidence must freeze those choices.

official_sources.title: gdal_rasterize
official_sources.finding: Vector-to-raster membership can update pixels after on-the-fly reprojection; rasterization semantics must match the canonical target grid.

official_sources.title: RFC 58 NoData removal
official_sources.finding: NoData metadata may be removed or represented through PAM/driver mechanisms; validity semantics cannot be inferred from value alone.

official_sources.title: gdal raster clip
official_sources.finding: Geometry clip and bbox/window clip have different semantics; pixels outside geometry may become nodata/zero and out-of-bounds windows need explicit handling.

official_sources.title: gdal vector rasterize
official_sources.finding: Target extent, resolution and target-aligned-pixels control the rasterized grid; optimization mode should not change result semantics.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info
official_sources.finding: Reports input coordinates, derived column/line, raw and unscaled values, and VRT contributing source files for independent cell replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster compare
official_sources.finding: Golden comparison can check dimensions, pixels, datatype, nodata, CRS, geotransform and metadata; skipped checks weaken equivalence.

official_sources.title: GTI driver
official_sources.finding: GTI mosaics support overlap z-order, masks/alpha, source SRS differences, explicit extent/resolution and band scale/offset/unit metadata.

official_sources.title: gdal_translate
official_sources.finding: srcwin/projwin can select source windows; out-of-bounds regions can write zero/nodata unless error-on-partial/outside options are used.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info
official_sources.finding: Reports georeferencing, masks, nodata and metadata; approximate statistics explicitly use a subset and cannot be terminal exact extrema.

official_sources.title: gdal raster fill-nodata
official_sources.finding: Fill-nodata creates interpolated values from valid neighbors and therefore must not enter exact native elevation extrema.

official_sources.title: RFC 15 Band Masks
official_sources.finding: Mask bands use zero for invalid and nonzero for valid; masks may derive from nodata, alpha or external .msk state.

official_sources.title: gdal raster calc
official_sources.finding: Extent/CRS checks and nodata propagation are configurable; disabling consistency checks can create numerically plausible but spatially invalid results.

official_sources.title: gdal raster reproject
official_sources.finding: Reprojection derives output extent/resolution and maps output pixels to source regions; resampled output is not native-cell terminal evidence.

official_sources.title: gdal raster footprint
official_sources.finding: Footprints are generated from valid-pixel masks/nodata and can be simplified/densified/reprojected after vectorization; raw validity footprint and post-processing must be distinguished.

official_sources.title: gdal raster index
official_sources.finding: Creates one footprint feature per raster and stores source filename/path; useful for independently enumerating actual tile coverage.

official_sources.title: gdal raster clean-collar
official_sources.finding: Clean-collar alters validity/alpha around image edges; derived masks cannot silently redefine canonical elevation coverage.

official_sources.title: gdal raster as-features
official_sources.finding: Can emit one feature per pixel with ROW/COL and CENTER_X/CENTER_Y, enabling independent pixel-center/address audit.

official_sources.title: GDAL configuration options
official_sources.finding: Runtime cache/dataset-pool configuration can affect performance/resource behavior; exact runtime configuration should be logged for reproducibility.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand class
official_sources.finding: ReadBlock reads native blocks without resampling/type conversion; edge blocks can be partial and GetActualBlockSize identifies valid dimensions.

official_sources.title: gdal raster edit
official_sources.finding: CRS, bounding box and metadata can be edited without reprojecting/subsetting; mutable metadata cannot replace immutable source-byte provenance.

official_sources.title: gdal raster convert
official_sources.finding: Format conversion creates a new dataset; converted output requires pixel/metadata equivalence checks before use as evidence.

official_sources.title: gdal raster tile
official_sources.finding: Tiling/resampling and nodata transparency thresholds can alter derived web tiles; publication tiles are not terminal numeric source cells.

official_sources.title: GTiff driver
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF metadata, masks, nodata and overview behavior can live in internal/external structures; full file list and mask state are part of provenance.

candidates.name: Affine pixel-center and corner address ledger
candidates.policy_note: Pixel centers/corners serialized from native geotransform; no integer-coordinate center assumption.

candidates.name: PixelIsArea/PixelIsPoint half-pixel guard
candidates.policy_note: AREA_OR_POINT semantics checked and half-pixel drift rejected.

candidates.name: Row/column ↔ georeferenced coordinate round-trip chain
candidates.policy_note: Native cell address round-trips through geotransform/inverse with exact cell identity.

candidates.name: Project half-open seam ownership policy
candidates.policy_note: Shared tile edges use one documented project-defined half-open ownership rule, not an invented GDAL guarantee.

candidates.name: Partial right/bottom block valid-size guard
candidates.policy_note: Edge blocks use GetActualBlockSize and never scan undefined padding.

candidates.name: Native ReadBlock full-resolution extrema chain
candidates.policy_note: ReadBlock/native blocks scanned without resampling or datatype conversion.

candidates.name: RasterIO no-overview/no-resample terminal replay
candidates.policy_note: Terminal window replay preserves native size/type and rejects overview substitution.

candidates.name: Mask/nodata/alpha unified validity chain
candidates.policy_note: Validity uses mask flags/band plus typed nodata and alpha provenance.

candidates.name: Tile footprint versus actual valid-pixel footprint chain
candidates.policy_note: Tile bounding footprint and valid-data footprint are separately checked.

candidates.name: GTI overlap z-order/mask deterministic source chain
candidates.policy_note: Overlaps pin sort/z-order, mask and contributing tile identity.

candidates.name: VRT overlap/source-window freeze chain
candidates.policy_note: VRT source order, srcwin/dstwin, resampling, nodata and geotransform are frozen.

candidates.name: No uncovered-zero elevation chain
candidates.policy_note: Uncovered mosaic pixels cannot silently become valid elevation zero.

candidates.name: Independent pixel-as-feature center audit chain
candidates.policy_note: ROW/COL/CENTER_X/CENTER_Y replay independently verifies extrema cell addresses.

candidates.name: Golden pixels+CRS+geotransform+metadata comparison chain
candidates.policy_note: Independent converted/cache artifacts must match golden visible pixels and spatial metadata.

candidates.name: Runtime block/cache config provenance chain
candidates.policy_note: Cache/pool/block configuration recorded without treating performance choices as numeric changes.

candidates.name: Terminal multi-tile seam bundle cross-check chain
candidates.policy_note: Complete coverage, no double-count seam, native values, masks and source contributor replay all agree.
